definitions.explanation: An online video game genre where large numbers of players interact in a virtual world simultaneously.

examples.japanese: MMO⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧MMO⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧だ。
examples.english: This MMO has a monthly subscription fee.

notes:
MMO stands for 'Massively Multiplayer Online.' It refers to online games where many players share a virtual world.

COMMON TERMS:
- MMORPG (MMO + RPG): massively multiplayer online role-playing game
- MMO⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: MMO game

GAME FEATURES:
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧: monthly subscription
- ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free to play (F2P)
- ギルド: guild (player group)
- ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧⟦アイテム→アイテム：07813_aitemu⟧: paid items
- PvP (⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧): player vs. player
- PvE (⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧): player vs. environment
